title: Authorize roadmap tickets P02-01 and P02-02 with the full P02 data-integrity task scope

source.execution_instruction: Owner instruction in this session to implement the local CURRENT_TASK.md (P02 global football data integrity) from start to finish on a branch from main, followed by owner answers to four scoped questions

scope: Roadmap tickets P02-01 (root-cause investigation) and P02-02 (verified ingestion and publication corrections) on branch ft/p02-data-integrity

The task's wider sections built in the same pull request: shared result and form policies, one governed recent-form engine, the bounded read-only integrity audit, and the foundations for integrity findings, dependency-aware refresh and review escalation on the existing work registry
authorizes: code and test changes in the existing Python, Go, SQL and web owners
additive SQL migrations applied to disposable databases only
read-only queries against the operating database and GET requests to the local API for baseline capture and the audit
documentation commits that amend the roadmap and record evidence

product_decisions.default_form: The fixture page shows the last 5 official results across all competitive matches, newest first. Awarded results are included and visibly marked. Friendlies are excluded. Played-only form stays the basis for goal averages, team statistics and forecast inputs.
product_decisions.score_basis: W/D/L uses the score after extra time. A match decided on penalties counts as a draw with the shootout winner as an annotation. Half-time scores are never used. A row with UNKNOWN score basis is excluded from played-only form and flagged.

requires: fix shared causes in their earliest owner; no production code branches on a specific team, fixture, competition, country, provider or form string
keep unknown, missing and unverified data distinct from verified data
leave published forecasts, model artifacts and historical cutoffs unchanged
report audit coverage honestly; anything not checked is NOT_AUDITED
open a pull request against main and leave it unmerged
explicitly_not_authorized: applying migrations or any other write to the operating database
provider acquisition, backfill or broad historical reprocessing
model training, promotion, retirement or republication
Architecture V2 cutover, merging or deploying
the remaining proposed roadmap phases (P03 onwards) beyond the compatible foundations this task names
supersession: Adds P02-01 and P02-02 to the authorized unified-architecture tickets. The investigation's implementation_of_proposed_architecture_authorized flag stays false for every other proposed phase. The default staleness and audit limits are the task's suggested values, taken without a separate owner answer.
